name: hole_wizard_follows_the_table
why: ENTRY Z-C6, the second half. `hole_wizard` was in the catalogue with cases only in the REGRESSION (r01, r02, r07, r14), which runs only with `-Regression`, and in the C# of the bench: no declared case of a normal run touched it. The new contract check found it, on 25/9/2026.
defect_caught: The hole that comes out with the wrong size for the TYPE: a threaded M8 wants the 6.8 tap drill (the thread is cosmetic), an M8 clearance hole wants the 9 hole. Swapping them makes a part where the screw either does not go in or does not hold, and the rebuild is clean just the same. `diameter_machined_mm` is told by the operation; the volume is confirmed by the part.

expect.tolerance_why: the tap drill of the M8 from the ISO table of SOLIDWORKS, read back: the thousandth is rounding
expect.why: THREADED = tap drill, not the diameter of the screw

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 minus pi x 3.4^2 x 20 = 726.336: pi inside, the hundredth is rounding. A hole of 8 would remove 1005.3
the clearance hole of the M8 (medium series ISO 273) from the table, read back
expect.why: CLEARANCE = the screw goes through it, so wider than the screw

expect.tolerance_why: minus pi x 4.5^2 x 20 = 1272.345: pi inside
